title: Release Prep & Change Approval & Deployment
goal: Turn verified increments into a release that is scoped, approved as a change, explained to its readers and decided on evidence. Promote the verified build to production automatically and reversibly, with exposure off, so deployment carries no user risk.
story: You ship it safely: a small group first, watch the signals, then everyone — always with a way back. In the example: one team for a week behind a switch, then all teams.
